crossRefs.note: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, near their brothers.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Shimeah
people.line: Son of Mikloth and nephew of Ner in Benjamin's genealogy.

translations.web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, near their brothers.
translations.bsb: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
translations.asv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
